integrity: All proofs and computations described are those of the present result. The self-review is not independent validation; prior literature supplies context and established lemmas, not invented authorship or certification.
scientific_limitations: Prime fields p congruent to 3 modulo 4, p at least 7, and the fourth moment only. The proof invokes the standard Weil bound for squarefree cubic character sums; the finite checks do not prove the infinite family. A bibliographically equivalent older phase-rigidity result cannot be categorically excluded.
title: Sharp Paley fourth moments and the phase-rigidity threshold
